_comment: The layouts chosen last for the emulation (layout.emulated_layout_recents) and the quick choices of the « Layout to emulate » menu, replayed by macOS and Linux (_shared/layouts/engine/emulation/recents.lua) and Windows (windows/modules/keymap/keylayout/emulation_recents.ahk) so the three menus draw the same rows. Each case uses count 3, the shipped emulation.recent_count of _shared/layouts/data/defaults.json, which the count field pins. after: the list once choice is chosen. quick: the ids drawn under « None » while current is in force, offered naming the layouts the catalogue lists.

after.name: a first choice starts the list
the chosen layout moves to the head
a fourth layout drops the oldest
choosing the head again keeps the order

quick.name: nothing chosen yet offers None alone
None in force still offers the recent layouts
the layout in force leads even when no menu chose it
the layout in force is not drawn twice
a recent layout the catalogue no longer lists is left out
